cc_cdc_4phase_src.summary: Source side of a 4-phase CDC handshake: an FSM samples valid data into glitch-free registers, raises async request, and waits for the synchronized ack to assert then deassert.

blocks.name: Handshake FSM
blocks.description: Sequences 4-phase req/ack and local ready

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: Handshake FSM: IDLE, wait ack assert, wait ack deassert

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Source ready decoded from FSM state and ack

anchors.name: req_src_q
anchors.why: Registered glitch-free request driving async_req_o

blocks.name: Data register
blocks.description: Holds payload stable on async data output

anchors.name: data_src_q
anchors.why: Data latched on accept, held stable across the async transfer

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Payload sampled into data register on valid

anchors.name: async_data_o
anchors.why: Asynchronous data bus to destination domain

blocks.name: Ack synchronizer
blocks.description: Multi-stage synchronizer bringing ack into source clock

anchors.name: ack_synced
anchors.why: Synchronized async ack steering FSM transitions and ready

anchors.name: async_ack_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous ack input fed to synchronizer

blocks.name: Async request
blocks.description: Local valid converted to async request

anchors.name: async_req_o
anchors.why: Asynchronous request to destination domain

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Source valid; starts transfer and samples data in IDLE

cc_cdc_4phase_dst.summary: Destination side of a 4-phase CDC handshake: synchronizes async request, a 3-state FSM issues valid downstream and a glitch-free registered ack, with an optional spill register decoupling output data.

blocks.name: Handshake FSM
blocks.description: Synchronized request handling and ack generation.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: Handshake FSM IDLE/WAIT_DOWNSTREAM_ACK/WAIT_REQ_DEASSERT controlling data_valid and ack.

anchors.name: req_synced
anchors.why: Synchronized request driving FSM transitions and data_valid.

anchors.name: ack_dst_q
anchors.why: Glitch-filtered ack register driving async_ack_o.

anchors.name: data_valid
anchors.why: FSM-decoded valid into spill register or valid_o.

blocks.name: Async interface
blocks.description: 4-phase req/ack and data from source clock domain.

anchors.name: async_req_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous request from source domain, synchronized into req_synced.

anchors.name: async_ack_o
anchors.why: Asynchronous acknowledge to source domain from registered ack_dst_q.

anchors.name: async_data_i
anchors.why: Data bus from source domain, captured into spill register or passed through.

blocks.name: Output decoupling
blocks.description: Spill register or pass-through to destination valid/ready.

anchors.name: output_ready
anchors.why: Downstream/spill ready steering FSM to WAIT_REQ_DEASSERT.

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Destination-domain valid output.

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Destination-domain ready input.

anchors.name: data_o
anchors.why: Destination-domain data output.

cc_cdc_reset_ctrlr_half.summary: Half of a CDC clear/reset controller: an initiator FSM steps through isolate/clear phases sent over a 4-phase CDC, while a receiver tracks remote phases; isolate/clear outputs are ORed.

blocks.name: Initiator FSM
blocks.description: Clear-triggered FSM stepping isolate/clear phases, waiting for local acks and CDC phase delivery.

anchors.name: initiator_state_q
anchors.why: Initiator FSM sequencing ISOLATE, CLEAR, POST_CLEAR phases and driving phase transfer requests.

anchors.name: clear_i
anchors.why: Clear request starting the initiator isolate/clear sequence from IDLE.

anchors.name: initiator_phase_transition_req
anchors.why: FSM-driven valid into source CDC requesting phase transfer.

anchors.name: initiator_phase_transition_ack
anchors.why: Source CDC ready advancing initiator FSM after phase delivery.

anchors.name: initiator_clear_seq_phase
anchors.why: Current initiator phase value fed as data into source CDC.

blocks.name: Receiver phase tracker
blocks.description: Captures remote phases, decodes isolate/clear, acknowledges after local isolate/clear acks.

anchors.name: receiver_phase_q
anchors.why: Receiver phase register captured from remote side; decodes receiver isolate/clear outputs.

anchors.name: receiver_phase_pending_q
anchors.why: Marks a captured phase awaiting local acknowledge; blocks recapture and enables ack.

anchors.name: receiver_phase_done_q
anchors.why: Prevents recapturing a phase until the CDC request deasserts.

anchors.name: receiver_capture_phase
anchors.why: Enables loading receiver_phase_q from CDC output and sets pending.

anchors.name: receiver_phase_ack
anchors.why: Ready to destination CDC once local isolate/clear acknowledged.

anchors.name: receiver_phase_req
anchors.why: Valid from destination CDC signalling a new remote phase.

blocks.name: Phase CDC link
blocks.description: 4-phase CDC source and destination transferring clear-sequence phases between domains.

anchors.name: async_req_o
anchors.why: Async 4-phase request carrying initiator phase to the other domain.

anchors.name: async_next_phase_o
anchors.why: Async phase payload sent to the other domain by the source CDC.

anchors.name: async_ack_i
anchors.why: Async acknowledge from the other domain for initiator phase transfer.

anchors.name: async_next_phase_i
anchors.why: Async phase payload received from the other domain's initiator.

anchors.name: async_req_i
anchors.why: Async request from the other domain into the destination CDC.

anchors.name: async_ack_o
anchors.why: Async acknowledge returned by destination CDC to the other domain.

blocks.name: Isolate/clear outputs
blocks.description: ORs initiator and receiver isolate/clear requests toward attached CDCs; collects acks.

anchors.name: isolate_o
anchors.why: Isolate request to attached CDCs, OR of initiator and receiver isolate.

anchors.name: clear_o
anchors.why: Clear request to attached CDCs, OR of initiator and receiver clear.

anchors.name: isolate_ack_i
anchors.why: Isolation acknowledge gating initiator ISOLATE exit and receiver phase ack.

anchors.name: clear_ack_i
anchors.why: Clear acknowledge gating initiator CLEAR exit and receiver phase ack.

cc_cdc_2phase_src_clearable.summary: Source half of a clearable two-phase CDC: accepted data is latched and a request toggle flips, with ready derived from a synchronized acknowledge toggle.

blocks.name: src_handshake
blocks.description: Two-phase request toggle and synchronized ack compare producing ready.

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Source valid; with ready_o accepts data and toggles request.

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Ready when request toggle equals synchronized ack toggle.

anchors.name: req_src_q
anchors.why: Request phase toggle register; flipped on accept, cleared by clear_i, compared with ack.

anchors.name: async_req_o
anchors.why: Two-phase request toggle to destination, copy of req_src_q.

anchors.name: async_ack_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous ack toggle from destination, synchronized into ack_synced.

blocks.name: data_hold
blocks.description: Latches source data and drives it across the clock domain.

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Source payload latched into data_src_q on handshake.

anchors.name: data_src_q
anchors.why: Holds accepted data stable during the asynchronous transfer.

anchors.name: async_data_o
anchors.why: Held payload crossing to destination domain from data_src_q.

cc_cdc_2phase_clearable_src.summary: Source side of a clearable two-phase CDC: a two-phase source half transfers payload while a reset-controller half sequences isolate/clear phases across domains, gating valid/ready during isolation.

blocks.name: payload_cdc_src
blocks.description: Two-phase CDC source latching payload and toggling request.

anchors.name: src_data_i
anchors.why: Source-domain payload forwarded to the two-phase CDC source.

anchors.name: src_valid_i
anchors.why: Source valid, gated by isolate request before CDC source.

anchors.name: src_ready_o
anchors.why: Source ready from CDC source, masked during isolation.

anchors.name: async_payload_req_o
anchors.why: Two-phase request toggle to the destination domain.

anchors.name: async_payload_ack_i
anchors.why: Two-phase acknowledge toggle from destination domain.

anchors.name: async_payload_data_o
anchors.why: Latched payload crossing to destination domain.

blocks.name: clear_controller
blocks.description: Reset-controller half sequencing isolate and clear phases across domains.

anchors.name: src_clear_i
anchors.why: Requests a synchronized clear sequence of the CDC.

anchors.name: src_isolate_req
anchors.why: Isolation request gating valid and ready during clear sequence.

anchors.name: src_clear_req
anchors.why: Clear request from reset controller clearing the CDC source.

anchors.name: src_isolate_ack_q
anchors.why: One-cycle-delayed acknowledge of isolate request.

anchors.name: src_clear_ack_q
anchors.why: One-cycle-delayed acknowledge of clear request.

anchors.name: src_clear_pending_o
anchors.why: Indicates clear sequence in progress (isolate asserted).

anchors.name: async_reset_next_phase_o
anchors.why: Clear-sequence phase sent to destination reset controller.

anchors.name: async_reset_req_o
anchors.why: Request for clear-phase transfer to destination.

anchors.name: async_reset_ack_i
anchors.why: Acknowledge of outgoing clear-phase transfer.

anchors.name: async_reset_next_phase_i
anchors.why: Clear-sequence phase received from destination controller.

anchors.name: async_reset_req_i
anchors.why: Incoming clear-phase request from destination.

anchors.name: async_reset_ack_o
anchors.why: Acknowledge for incoming clear-phase transfer.

cc_cdc_2phase_dst_clearable.summary: Destination side of a clearable two-phase CDC: synchronizes the toggling request, detects phase transitions to capture async data, presents it as valid/ready and toggles the ack.

blocks.name: request_sync
blocks.description: Synchronizer and delay register detecting request phase transitions.

anchors.name: async_req_i
anchors.why: Two-phase async request toggle, synchronized by tc_sync.

anchors.name: req_synced
anchors.why: Synchronizer output of async request; transition triggers data capture.

anchors.name: req_synced_q1
anchors.why: Delayed synchronized request phase; edge detect and valid comparison with ack.

blocks.name: ack_toggle
blocks.description: Ack phase register toggled on accepted handshake, cleared by clear_i.

anchors.name: async_ack_o
anchors.why: Two-phase ack toggle back to source, driven by ack_dst_q.

blocks.name: data_capture
blocks.description: Captures async data and holds it for destination output.

anchors.name: async_data_i
anchors.why: Async data captured into data_dst_q on request transition.

anchors.name: data_dst_q
anchors.why: Captured data held until destination handshake completes; drives data_o.

anchors.name: data_o
anchors.why: Destination-domain data output from data_dst_q.

blocks.name: dst_handshake
blocks.description: Destination valid/ready handshake.

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Valid when ack phase differs from synced request phase.

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Downstream ready; with valid_o toggles ack_dst_q.

cc_cdc_2phase_clearable_dst.summary: Destination side of a clearable two-phase CDC: a two-phase destination half captures payload while a reset-controller half sequences isolate/clear phases, gating valid/ready during isolation.

blocks.name: payload_cdc_dst
blocks.description: Two-phase CDC destination capturing payload on request toggles.

anchors.name: async_payload_data_i
anchors.why: Payload arriving from source domain into CDC destination.

anchors.name: async_payload_req_i
anchors.why: Two-phase request toggle from source domain.

anchors.name: async_payload_ack_o
anchors.why: Two-phase acknowledge toggle back to source domain.

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: Captured payload presented in destination domain.

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Destination valid from CDC dst, masked during isolation.

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Destination ready, gated by isolate request.

blocks.name: clear_controller
blocks.description: Reset-controller half sequencing isolate and clear phases across domains.

anchors.name: dst_clear_i
anchors.why: Requests a synchronized clear sequence of the CDC.

anchors.name: dst_isolate_req
anchors.why: Isolation request gating valid and ready during clear sequence.

anchors.name: dst_clear_req
anchors.why: Clear request from reset controller clearing CDC destination.

anchors.name: dst_isolate_ack_q
anchors.why: One-cycle-delayed acknowledge of isolate request.

anchors.name: dst_clear_ack_q
anchors.why: One-cycle-delayed acknowledge of clear request.

anchors.name: dst_clear_pending_o
anchors.why: Indicates clear sequence in progress (isolate asserted).

anchors.name: async_reset_next_phase_o
anchors.why: Clear-sequence phase sent to source reset controller.

anchors.name: async_reset_req_o
anchors.why: Request for clear-phase transfer to source.

anchors.name: async_reset_ack_i
anchors.why: Acknowledge of outgoing clear-phase transfer.

anchors.name: async_reset_next_phase_i
anchors.why: Clear-sequence phase received from source controller.

anchors.name: async_reset_req_i
anchors.why: Incoming clear-phase request from source.

anchors.name: async_reset_ack_o
anchors.why: Acknowledge for incoming clear-phase transfer.

cc_cdc_2phase_clearable.summary: Clearable two-phase clock-domain-crossing channel: source and destination halves exchange payload via a 2-phase req/ack handshake and coordinate isolate/clear phases through cross-coupled reset-controller handshakes.

blocks.name: Source half
blocks.description: Accepts source stream, launches 2-phase req, runs source clear controller.

anchors.name: src_data_i
anchors.why: Source-domain payload accepted by the source half.

anchors.name: src_valid_i
anchors.why: Source-side valid starting a payload transfer.

anchors.name: src_ready_o
anchors.why: Source-side ready, gated during isolation.

anchors.name: src_clear_i
anchors.why: Source-side clear request starting the clear sequence.

anchors.name: src_clear_pending_o
anchors.why: Source-side isolate/clear in progress indication.

blocks.name: Destination half
blocks.description: Captures payload, returns ack, runs destination clear controller.

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: Destination-domain payload output from destination half.

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Destination valid indicating captured payload.

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Destination ready consuming payload and triggering ack.

anchors.name: dst_clear_i
anchors.why: Destination-side clear request starting the clear sequence.

anchors.name: dst_clear_pending_o
anchors.why: Destination-side isolate/clear in progress indication.

blocks.name: Async payload channel
blocks.description: Two-phase req/ack toggles and stable payload crossing domains.

anchors.name: async_payload_req

anchors.name: async_payload_ack
anchors.why: Two-phase acknowledge toggle crossing dst to src.

anchors.name: async_payload_data
anchors.why: Payload held stable across domains during handshake.

blocks.name: Clear sequencing handshake
blocks.description: Cross-coupled phase handshakes coordinating isolate and clear.

anchors.name: async_reset_src2dst_req
anchors.why: Clear-phase request from source controller to destination.

anchors.name: async_reset_src2dst_next_phase
anchors.why: Clear sequence phase (isolate/clear/post-clear) sent src to dst.

anchors.name: async_reset_dst2src_req
anchors.why: Clear-phase request from destination controller to source.
